description: `create((set, get) => initialState)` builds a store and returns a hook that is also the store API (`getState`, `setState`, `subscribe`).
Updates the store. Objects are shallow-merged into the current state; pass a function to read the current state first.
Function passed to the hook, such as `(state) => state.count`. The component re-renders only when its result changes by `Object.is`.
Wraps a selector that returns a new object or array so it is compared field by field. Imported from `zustand/react/shallow`.
Wrappers such as `persist`, `devtools` and `immer` from `zustand/middleware` that enhance the store initializer.
